nightgauge.cloud.enabled.description: Enable cloud features (hosted dashboard, team management, remote pipeline control, accounts, billing). nightgauge.telemetry.enabled.description: Send anonymous usage data to help improve Nightgauge. On by default — set to false to opt out. Never includes source code, file contents, secrets, branch names, or commit SHAs. Honors VS Code's telemetry.telemetryLevel as a hard kill switch. See docs/TELEMETRY_PRIVACY.md for what is collected.
nightgauge.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription: Send anonymous usage data to help improve Nightgauge. **On by default** — set to `false` to opt out. Never includes source code, file contents, secrets, branch names, or commit SHAs, and VS Code's `#telemetry.telemetryLevel#` is honored as a hard kill switch. See [TELEMETRY_PRIVACY.md](command:nightgauge.openTelemetrySettingsPanel) for what is collected.

nightgauge.telemetry.streams.description: Telemetry streams that may send data when telemetry is enabled.

nightgauge.telemetry.uploadIntervalMinut.description: How often (in minutes) the telemetry queue flushes when telemetry is enabled.

nightgauge.backend.binaryPath.description: Path to nightgauge Go binary. Leave empty to search PATH.

nightgauge.backend.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for Go backend operations

nightgauge.git.autoCleanupBranches.description: Automatically delete local branches whose remote tracking branch was removed after PR merge. Runs on extension startup.

nightgauge.attention.sweepEnabled.description: Check each workspace repository for standing blockers (a failing default branch, a green PR nobody can merge) even when no pipeline run is in flight. Results appear in the Attention view.

nightgauge.attention.sweepIntervalMinute.description: How often to re-check repositories for standing blockers while this window is open. The conditions it finds persist for hours, so a long interval costs almost nothing in freshness and saves API quota; values between 1 and 5 are raised to 5. Set to 0 to check only on activation, on refresh, and after a run finishes.

enumDescriptions: Nightgauge reports whatever it has observed. This is today's behaviour exactly.
Claude Max 20x — a subscription with 5-hour and weekly allowances.
Claude Max 5x — a subscription with 5-hour and weekly allowances.
Claude Pro — a subscription with 5-hour and weekly allowances.
API key / pay-per-token — dollar windows are the right answer, and Nightgauge stops asking about plans.
nightgauge.usage.claudePlan.markdownDescription:
Which Claude plan you are on.

Nightgauge can only *observe* a subscription allowance once a `rate_limit_event` reading has arrived, so on a fresh install — or any window where the usage feed has never been wired — the footer falls through to locally-derived dollar windows that describe pay-per-token billing. Declaring your plan tells Nightgauge which windows your plan has.

It never supplies the numbers in them: an observed reading always outranks this setting for utilization, and a declared plan with no reading yet renders as *awaiting first reading* rather than as zero.

scripts.pretest:host: bash scripts/check-test-collection.sh && bash scripts/check-test-runner-coverage.sh && tsc -p tests/vscode-host --noEmit
